COMPARE.resampling_unit: ISO week of the graded close

decided: operator, 2026-10-07 (22:51Z): open v3, freeze before the next containment call, include the time-of-day and release matching as a declared secondary
freeze_rule: v3 is frozen at the time this file was first pushed to main (GitHub activity API push record). Only calls whose registry receipt is later count. Pre-freeze calls - the seven v1 calls of Oct 6-7 and any other - are never v3 evidence. A change to any of the above is v4 with its own cohort and freeze.
not_looked_at: no v3 baseline or outcome was computed for any registered call before this freeze; one smoke test ran on a hypothetical call (2026-10-04 08:26:37Z, not a registered call) after the spec hash was fixed, to check data loading (1,052,640 1m closes, 89 s; one daily file retrieval_error) and runtime (0.2 s per baseline). No constant changed after it.

spec.anchor: the last 1m close at or before issue_utc - the data cutoff; nothing later is read
spec.bounds: k_up = ln(upper/issue_price) / sigma_issue, k_dn = ln(issue_price/lower) / sigma_issue; each in [0.05, 8]
spec.data: Binance USD-M perp 1m closes through jbm_archive (validated, provider checksums); load_closes_1m
spec.horizon: H = graded_close_utc - anchor in whole minutes, 15 <= H <= 4320 (72 h); graded close on a whole minute
spec.inside: -k_dn x sigma_t <= ln(C(t+H) / C(t)) <= k_up x sigma_t
spec.lean_drift: mean H-minute log return over the primary window set
spec.missing: a window needing any absent close is skipped; unavailable below 2,000 usable windows or 95 % usability
spec.outcome: containment: lower <= the 1m close ending at graded_close_utc <= upper
spec.secondary: declared, reported beside the primary and never replacing it: the primary's windows restricted to a start hour (UTC) within +-2 h of the anchor's (circular), the same weekday/weekend class (UTC date), and containing a scheduled release (data/releases_2020_2026.csv: CPI, NFP, PPI, FOMC) in (t, t+H] iff the call's (anchor, graded close] does; unavailable below 300 windows
spec.sigma: sd (n-1) of the 24 non-overlapping 60-minute log returns ending at a window start, x sqrt(H/60)
spec.statistic: paired() unchanged; v3 units form their own cohort; the comparative claim reads the primary only
spec.windows: starts t = anchor - j hours (the anchor's minute of the hour), t - 24 h >= anchor - 730 days, t + H <= anchor

test: O33 v3 — registered desk calls against per-call matched baselines
